description: This file defines the interface 'FieldHandlerInterface' for Drupal's Views module, specifying methods for handling view fields such as sorting, rendering, and entity retrieval.

classes.name: FieldHandlerInterface
classes.description: Interface for field handlers in Drupal Views, extending ViewsHandlerInterface and defining methods for field operations.

methods.name: clickSort
methods.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause to the query for click sort columns.

methods.name: clickSortable
methods.description: Determines if this field is click sortable.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Gets this field's label.

methods.name: elementType
methods.description: Returns an HTML element based upon the field's element type.

methods.name: elementLabelType
methods.description: Returns an HTML element for the label based upon the field's element type.

methods.name: elementWrapperType
methods.description: Returns a wrapper HTML element for the field.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Provides a list of elements valid for field HTML.

methods.name: elementClasses
methods.description: Returns the class of the field.

methods.name: tokenizeValue
methods.description: Replaces a value with tokens from the last field.

methods.name: elementLabelClasses
methods.description: Returns the class of the field's label.

methods.name: elementWrapperClasses
methods.description: Returns the class of the field's wrapper.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Gets the entity matching the current row and relationship.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the value that's supposed to be rendered.

methods.name: useStringGroupBy
methods.description: Determines if this field can be grouped in the results.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Runs before any fields are rendered to set up the handler.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the field for a given row.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Runs after a field has been rendered, for cache or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: advancedRender
methods.description: Renders a field using advanced settings, such as links or text replacements.

methods.name: isValueEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a field value is considered empty.

methods.name: renderText
methods.description: Performs an advanced text render for list items.

methods.name: getRenderTokens
methods.description: Gets tokens for advanced rendering.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Renders row values using theme functions.
